notes.title: The Infinity Update Is Now Live!
notes.notes:

notes.title: The Mew World Update is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Catventurers!

Today is finally the day, the day where we celebrate International Cat Day! 
A few notable things – it’s the 3rd anniversary of Cat Quest coming out on Steam! Thank you all for your support thus far! 

Which brings us to the second piece of news: the Cat Quest franchise has already sold 1.3 million units since it first came out, isn’t that clawsome?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/ae09d386a55c1ac884308b0259cd998b920f8f04.jpg[/img]
	

Finally, onto our piece de resistance, the Mew World Update is live for Cat Quest II! 
It’s free for everyone who already owns the game, and there is a limited-time discount to celebrate this occasion!
This update has created by The Gentlebros as a [i]‘huge thank you to all our fans who’ve supported us since day 1. We never thought our games would be played by so many people! We read every single review, and every message sent to us, and these improvements and tweaks are what we feel would make the game a lot more enjoyable for everyone![/i]’.


[b]The Mew Game[/b] 
There are now 8 meowdifiers you can equip once you’ve finished the story and choose a Mew Game. From no equipment to twice the speed or no magic at all, you can really challenge yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/565232a0477261aaa1004a0b6c66e635bc2db7fe.gif[/img]

Here's an example of the Naked Paws one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/11866b05c48b68e0187a433a88c48b6ac36d86d6.gif[/img]

Special tip: after you finish the Mew Game, a special set of armor will be unlocked for you! 


[b]Reworked inventory[/b]
A request of the fans, the sorting has been reworked and there is now a color code for rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/131f97c74066b48591dc750a8eefe0fa1681fea3.png[/img]


[b]Sprinting[/b]
As shown before, after running for a few seconds, your cat and dog will speed up and travel faster across the kingdoms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/06cc90aa92feda7993a0f13fddb293483f443c30.gif[/img]


[b]Elemental damage[/b]
You can now better see which weapons do what sort of elemental damage, and the numbers change color depending on which element you’re using!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/01657ac99252c719f54582f6b84ed46ee2bfccc6.png[/img]


[b]New enemies [/b]
You can now really challenge yourself while crossing the oceans and get a new source of XP and gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/093466cf5b79b0873e557e562595a45c956cf6bb.png[/img]


[b]New Royal Arts[/b]
As demonstrated, you now have a special attack, Pawer Smash remastered, that triggers whenever you roll and attack! Each weapon type has a different devastating attack! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8c06e2ad76fccc64663b896849b4b769b86fa997.gif[/img]


[b]Difficulty [/b]
Based on the feedback received, there is now a difficulty choice as well as tweak to balance out the weapon upgrades versus the enemies getting tougher as you get to higher levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/86b3ccde72b64c4f2f0ce8a2f610aaa965a2aef8.png[/img]


[b]Defense[/b]
The defense stat has been revamped and now works closer to how it did in Cat Quest! A shield is now over your life bar, and it will take damage first. It also recharges slowly over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/91be5ecf88ec3fe1c5019e9a42dd98bab88c1c79.jpg[/img]


[b]Quality of Life[/b]
A lot of tweaks will make the game smoother overall, but you’ll also be able to check the level of the quests and dungeons before you enter. The Kingsmaker also displays the general direction it will teleport you towards. You can now finally delete your save files! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/4375c8243df29abd0e93f5621b1b01071bacce1d.jpg[/img]


The game is now also discounted for the next 48 hours at 33% if you have Steam friends who don’t have the game yet!
We hope you enjoy this update and revamped catventure!
Thank you again for your suppawt! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/35c320672982a063898972da4bd8fc0fcac63eaa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mew World Update 4
notes.notes:
Dear Catventurers,

Time for another Mew World update! We're impurroving how the defense stat works! It's now displayed as a bar in front of your health, and it will take damage in place of it!
Don't worry, it will also recharge if you can avoid taking damage for a certain amount of time!

Hope everyone will love this new improvement, and get excited because the Mew World update is coming for free on August 8th, International Cat Day.

notes.title: Mew World Update
notes.notes:
Dear Catventurers, 

We have news for you! 

For our next update: Mew World, we are working on a whole host of QOL improvements as well as the much requested MEW GAME mode!

Today we'll be sharing the new improvements that will be made to the Inventory!
1. Items will now be color coded based on rarity!
2. We've added an ALL tab so you can better view all your items at one go!
3. We've improved the auto-sorting. It will now prioritize levels!
4. A new tab has been added to detail the Royal Arts you receive!

Hope you guys like the improvements we're making! The Mew World update will be pawing soon~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/4f6f6b6107610d31c1a263c85d8bfec7f4b6c1e5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Game + Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Fellow catventurers and doge knights! 

The New Game + update is now playable for all! Try your paws at the game again....but this time with all your levels and gear! Customize your difficulty(up to +999 levels) and challenge yourself to enemies so tough, your fur wouldn't stand a chance!

[b]How to unlock New Game +[/b]
1. Make sure you complete the epilogue. You must do this even if you had completed it before.
2. The option for New Game + should appear in the main menu.

Have fun, and do let us know your feedback!

PS: For those who were in the beta, you just need to opt out of it, and the game should just update itself automatically! Thank you for the help! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8250b8d1c5418bed29a33b11a44dd57298efe76b.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Optimisations, Tweaks and 21:9 Support!
notes.notes:
Hello Catventurers and Doge Knights!
We're excited to tell you guys the first patch for Cat Quest II is now LIVE!

[h1]Patch notes: [/h1]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed various crash bugs due to quests.
- Fixed various crash bugs due to co-op mode.
- Fixed a bug where dungeons were not completing.
- Fixed a bug where the Dungeon Master achievement was not triggering.
- Implemented various safeguards should the Settings file get corrupted.
- Implemented a handle should anti-virus prevent save files from being read.
- Minor bug fixes.

[b]Balance and tweaks[/b]
- Boss stats were tweaked.
- Spell stats were tweaked.(Lightnyan is stronger, Celestail is weaker)
- Mage weapons tweaked.(Mage weapon damage has been slightly reduced)
- Tutorials tweaked.(Tutorials now show that Mage weapons reduce 50% health more clearly)
- You can now access the map room in Purrn Cave normally.(use this to get the chest you missed!)
- Added 21:9 screen resolution support.

[b]Optimisations[/b]
- Optimisation done to some UI elements. (This should further increase fps for lower range computers)
- Increased overall stability.

Let us know if there are any issues with this patch(especially crashes!)!
We have more updates and improvements planned!
Hope everyone continues to enjoy Cat Quest II~!

-The Gentlebros

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8250b8d1c5418bed29a33b11a44dd57298efe76b.png[/img]
